name: South Bay Galleria
description: South Bay Galleria is a premier shopping destination boasting 3 levels of over 140 retailers including Macy's, Kohl's, and AMC Theaters. This regional mall serves the South Bay area of Los Angeles with a diverse mix of shopping, dining, and entertainment options in a multi-level enclosed format. The center features an on-site AMC Dine-In theater and remains committed to providing a welcoming experience for shoppers and the community.
summary: South Bay Galleria is a three-level regional mall featuring over 140 retailers including major anchors Macy's and Kohl's, plus an AMC Dine-In theater serving the South Bay Los Angeles community.
